_comment: I-302 -- hand-verified enUS strings for Neltharion rows that tdb434 cannot key.
Keys are SOURCE (Neltharion/Cata) ids, not the remapped 5xxxxx block, so this
fixture survives any renumbering of the port's id blocks.
Every string below was traced to a tdb434 broadcast_text row or to the stock
AzerothCore wording for that option type; none of it is invented.

gossip_menu_option.10618/0: I would like to check my deposit box.
gossip_menu_option.11047/0: I am interested in mage training.
gossip_menu_option.10816/0: I am interested in mage training.

35201/1/0.Text: This sparkling white wine is delicious! Wherever did you get it?
35201/1/0._src: tdb434 broadcast_text 35419 -- the shipped row is ~6 rounds of double encoding deep and unrecoverable by demojibake alone

35201/7/0._src: tdb434 broadcast_text 35425 -- shipped row is the French line machine-translated back
